content.title: How to reset your password
content.description: Step-by-step guide for resetting your account password.
content.content:
How to reset your password

If you have forgotten your password, follow the steps below.

  1. Go to the login page.
  2. Click Forgot password.
  3. Enter your work email address and submit.
  4. Open the reset email and click the link.
  5. Choose a new password that meets the complexity requirements.

If you do not receive the email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder or contact the service desk.
